reason: Although framed as a logic move/refactor, this PR is broad and central: it touches core physical TopN behavior across plan construction, costing, cloning/cache generation, protobuf conversion, explain/stringer output, index resolution, implementation rules, task building, and executor building. TopN is a common operator with direct impact on ORDER BY/LIMIT planning and runtime correctness, so regressions here can hide High-severity planner/executor bugs.
